$comment: Components Salesforce ships with an org, and the samples of a Developer Edition or a trial: set aside before anything is counted (facts.salesforceShipped). A rule matches when every condition it gives matches: name (regular expression on the API name), host (remote sites), folder (email templates), edition (regular expression on Organization.OrganizationType, from org facts: an unknown edition never matches). Types: apex, vfPage, staticResource, remoteSite, emailTemplate, namespace, assignmentRule, escalationRule, autoResponseRule, serviceChannel, routingConfig, presenceStatus, presenceConfig, callCenter, bot, genAiPlanner, genAiPlannerBundle, genAiPlugin, genAiFunction, genAiPromptTemplate.
